tutor_message.content: A useful concept for this problem is to recognize the connection between paths and parent-child relationships in a tree. A univalue path at any node can be understood as extending through its children only when they share the same value as the parent node. Thinking recursively about how a univalue path can be extended from the left or right child—based only on value equality—can help you reason about the longest such path in the tree.
